knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Caked residue supports flies and similar pests, so the container base is cleaned, not only emptied.
The source recommends loosening the caked layer first so that washing and spraying can remove it.
Tying bags shut before they enter the container limits odour, spills and pest access.

practicalCriteria: Learner loosens, washes and drains a practice container and shows the base is clear (pass: no caked residue at the base).
Learner ties bags and checks that the lid closes before returning the container (pass: both observed).
Learner records the cleaning and reports a simulated pest sign (pass: record and report made).
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Observer checklist for the container clean
Report note for the simulated pest sign
stopWorkCriteria: Sharps are found in the waste and the procedure for them is not known.
Wash-down water would enter a drain without the site's approval.
A pest sign is found in the waste area and the responsible person has not been reached.
A bin is too heavy or damaged to move safely.
